text:
alex: Quick heads-up 1: prelaunch checklist for the webinar landing. Need SEO tech pass, redirect mappings, and UA-preserved form routing before paid starts. Main worry: client-side behavioral redirects might distort organic benchmark numbers.

jess: Saw the same drop last time. Do we want to block JS redirects for crawlers until we go live? :thinking_face:

sam: Yes for crawlers. Also add canonical + sitemap priority for the landing so SERP doesn't flip during campaign. I'll add JSON-LD for Event schema.

alex: Engineering asks: (1) X-Robots-Tag: noindex on experimental variants until go-live, (2) avoid client-side 302s that rewrite path for tracking  prefer server 302 with Vary header or server-side rewrite, (3) a redirect-suppression toggle we can flip for QA.

marco: I can ship a safe nginx toggle. Snippet I used previously:
```
# toggle with ENV WEBINAR_SAFE_REDIRECT=1
if ($http_user_agent ~* "Googlebot|Bingbot|Slurp") {
  add_header X-Robots-Tag "index, follow";
} else {
  return 302 /variant/$arg_variant;
}
```

jess: Two SEO checks: Event structured data for the webinar, and consistent keyword-rich anchor text from Resources -> landing. We should patch top pages.

sam: For Event schema include startDate, endDate, location: "Online", offers: omitted if free. Add speakable for short blurb. I'll paste JSON-LD in the PR.

alex: Redirects map: legacy /webinar-old + campaign UTM variants. Need a whitelist + mapping doc so backlinks aren't orphaned. I'll pull top referring domains.

seo-bot: crawl-alert: 3 incoming links to /webinar-old from high-authority domains; currently 302 -> /campaign-temp. Recommendation: serve 301 with canonical to /webinar.

marco: Will change rule to 301 for those hostnames and keep 302 for experiment variants. Posting PR soon.

jess: Internal linking: enforce anchor text "Redwood Inference webinar" across docs and blog. Run anchor-text export and patch top 20 pages. Who can run export?

sam: I'll run Screaming Frog export and filter anchors. CSV by EOD.

alex: Messaging note for the launch post: include baseline benchmark numbers and call out savings: pref-cache example shows ~20% cost reduction.

marco: I'll add benchmark snippet in PR: "Benchmark: 25k concurrent tokens, p95 latency 220ms, cost/unit -20% vs baseline." Keep editable.

jess: Form routing: ensure UTM+referrer preserved across redirect chain so CRM receives utm_source. Server-side append before redirect is safest.

alex: Add test to checklist: submit form through redirect chain and validate CRM lead_source.

sam: I'll add a Playwright test: simulate redirect variant, submit form, assert CRM payload contains utm_source.

marco: PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/web/compare/webinar-redirect-safety>

jess: Owners: alex (product), marco (eng), sam (SEO/analytics). Follow-ups: attach ScreamingFrog CSV, PR link, and final redirect mapping before publish. :white_check_mark:
